works.title: Bhagavad Gita
works.author: Vyasa (attributed)
works.note: The dialogue between Arjuna and Krishna on duty, action and liberation, in Arnold’s verse.

works.title: The Upanishads
works.author: Ancient seers
works.note: The close of the Veda: the self, the absolute, and the path of knowledge.

works.title: Yoga Sutras of Patanjali
works.author: Patanjali
works.edition: The Book of the Spiritual Man (1912)
works.note: The aphorisms on discipline of mind: attention, practice, and the stilling of thought.

works.title: Vedanta Sutras with Shankara’s commentary
works.author: Badarayana
works.note: The Brahma Sutras with the Advaita commentary of Adi Shankara.

works.title: Ramayana
works.author: Valmiki
works.note: The epic of Rama: dharma in family, rule and exile, in verse.

works.title: Mahabharata (Book I)
works.author: Vyasa (attributed)
works.edition: The Mahabharata of Krishna-Dwaipayana Vyasa, Vol. I (1883–96)
works.note: The first book of the epic: origins, the house of Bharata, and the seeds of the war.

works.title: Hitopadesha & Hindu literature
works.author: Narayana (attributed)
works.note: The Book of Good Counsels (Hitopadesha) with Nala, Sakoontala and the epic in brief.

works.title: Sarva-Darshana-Samgraha
works.author: Madhavacharya
works.translator: E. B. Cowell & A. E. Gough
works.note: A tour of every Indian school of thought: Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Sankhya, Yoga, Mimamsa, Vedanta, Buddhist and Jaina.

works.title: Laws of Manu
works.author: Manu (attributed)
works.note: The classic text on social duty, law and the ordering of life.

works.title: Arthashastra
works.author: Kautilya (Chanakya)
works.note: The science of state, economy, administration and diplomacy.

works.title: Hymns of the Rigveda
works.author: Ancient seers
works.note: The oldest hymns: praise of the elements, of dawn, of speech and of the one reality.

works.title: Surya Siddhanta
works.author: Anonymous school (attributed to Surya)
works.edition: Translation of the Sûrya-Siddhânta, a Text-book of Hindu Astronomy (1860)
works.note: Indian astronomy and time reckoning: planetary motion, eclipses, calendars.

works.title: Algebra, Arithmetic and Mensuration — Brahmagupta & Bhaskara
works.author: Brahmagupta & Bhaskara II
works.edition: From the Sanscrit of Brahmegupta and Bháscara (1817)
works.note: Indian arithmetic, algebra and geometry, including the rules of zero, negative numbers and the “pulveriser”.

works.title: Thirukkural
works.author: Thiruvalluvar
works.edition: The Sacred Kurral of Tiruvalluva Nayanar (1886)
works.note: Tamil couplets on virtue, wealth and love — the ethics text of the south.

works.title: Sushruta Samhita
works.author: Sushruta
works.edition: An English Translation of the Sushruta Samhita (1907)
works.note: Surgery and medicine: diagnosis, treatment, instruments and the training of a physician.
